newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KOMERCNI SAYS RAISES REFERENCE RATE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KOMERCNI SAYS RAISES REFERENCE RATE.

text.p: Czech commercial bank Komercni Banka a.s. said on Friday it was raising its basic lending rate, the reference rate, to 12.6 percent from previous 12.5 percent, effective December 1.
The bank said in a statement that the change reflected the development of rates on the interbank market.
"Rates of all products tied to the reference rate are changing," the statement said.
The reference rate, by which the bank's schedule of standard credits are aligned, reacts to the six-month Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR). On Friday, PRIBOR stood at 12.60 percent.
